minutes.headline: Finance Committee heard FY16 cable and sewer budgets; only minutes and adjournment were voted.
minutes.summary: The Finance Committee heard FY16 budget presentations from the Public Access Cable Committee and the Sewer Commission. Questions covered reserves, a proposed mobile unit, retained earnings and betterment debt. The sewer commission outlined three warrant articles. The committee approved last week's minutes and adjourned. Next week it will prepare its budget recommendations.

what_happened.line: The Finance Committee heard the Sewer Commission's FY16 budget and three warrant articles, including an operating transfer and a borrowing for the Pleasant View betterment.
The Public Access Cable Committee presented an FY16 budget that includes money for a mobile unit and a remote site, with income running above expenses.
Sewer discussion covered a surplus returning to retained earnings, capacity fees going to a stabilization fund, and betterment revenue falling short of betterment debt payments.
The only votes were to approve last week's minutes and to adjourn; no budget was voted.
The committee said next week it will review recommendations for the public hearing and hear from the town manager on money articles.

why_it_matters: Sewer betterment revenue that does not cover betterment debt payments is drawn from the betterment account, and the borrowing article for the Pleasant View betterment is one residents may be asked to vote on at Town Meeting.
Cable payments from Comcast can be used only for public access, so the built-up cable balance does not bear on the tax bill, but it shapes what local meeting coverage the town can fund.
watch_next: Next week's Finance Committee meeting: recommendations for the public hearing and the town manager's briefing on money articles.
